notes: Indiana's all-state CHORAL programs are run by the Indiana Choral Directors Association (ICDA/InACDA), not by IMEA — ICDA administers the All-State Honor Choir, All-State Jazz Choir, and All-State Show Choir. The All-State Honor Choir is presented as part of the IMEA Professional Development Conference. IMEA itself sponsors the Elementary and Middle School/Junior High All-State Honor Choirs through its Circle the State with Song (CSWS) program. ICDA labels ensembles by calendar year of performance (e.g. '2027 All-State Honor Choir' = the 2026-27 school year); the All-State Show Choir performs in October, so ICDA's '2026 All-State Show Choir' falls in the 2026-27 school year and is recorded here as such with the state's own naming preserved. Area audition dates on the ICDA page are mixed: some areas had posted 2027 dates at retrieval and others still showed their 2026 (September 2025) dates — only the explicitly-labeled 2027 dates were recorded.

organization.name: Indiana Choral Directors Association
organization.description: ICDA is the Indiana chapter of the American Choral Directors Association. It administers Indiana's All-State Honor Choir, All-State Jazz Choir, and All-State Show Choir. Participation requires a sponsoring choral director who is an active ACDA member.

requirements.description: Auditions are recorded and submitted through the HeartOut mobile app using voice-part invitation codes provided by the organizer. Students get three recording takes. (Codes and window shown at retrieval were for the 2026 cycle.)

programs.description: ICDA's All-State Show Choir. ICDA labels this ensemble '2026', but it meets in October 2026, within the 2026-27 school year. 2026 guest clinicians: Kassy Krause (vocal clinician) and Ellie Jordan (choreographer).

dates.title: All-State Show Choir audition window
dates.description: Video vocal and dance auditions submitted online between August 1 and August 31, 2026.

dates.title: Indiana All-State Show Choir 2026

requirements.title: Open to high school-aged choral singers
requirements.description: Open to all high school-aged singers who participate regularly in a choral ensemble in their school or community led by a sponsoring choral director who is an active member of ACDA.

requirements.title: Vocal audition video
requirements.description: Record yourself singing the Star Spangled Banner in the assigned key — Soprano/Tenor in C, Alto/Bass in G (tonality and starting pitch tracks provided) — and upload the video. Label the video with last name, first initial, and 'Voice'. Say only your first and last name when recording (no hometown or school name).

requirements.title: Dance audition video
requirements.description: Learn the provided choreography, record yourself from the front with your entire body visible (feet to above your head), and upload. Label the video with last name, first initial, and 'Dance'.

repertoire.title: The Star Spangled Banner
repertoire.notes: Vocal audition selection; sung in C for Soprano/Tenor and G for Alto/Bass.

programs.name: 2027 IMEA Elementary All-State Honor Choir
programs.description: IMEA has sponsored an elementary honor choir since 1990. Approximately 150 singers are selected on the basis of teacher recommendations and recorded auditions, drawn from participants across all 12 Circle the State with Song area festivals.

dates.title: 2027 Elementary All-State Honor Choir performance
dates.description: IMEA lists the 2027 performance dates as TBD; the performance location is the Fort Wayne Embassy Theatre, Fort Wayne, IN.

requirements.title: Must attend a Circle the State with Song Area Festival
requirements.description: Students attending Circle the State with Song Area Festivals are eligible to audition for the All-State Honor Choirs.

requirements.title: Recorded audition submitted online
requirements.description: Auditions are recorded along with the audition tracks provided by IMEA and submitted online through the Circle the State with Song site. Audition instructions must be followed exactly; failure to follow instructions and meet deadlines disqualifies the audition.

requirements.title: Selection by CSWS Committee
requirements.description: Final selection is made by the CSWS Committee during the fall of 2026, based on teacher recommendations and auditions, with the goal of a well-balanced ensemble drawn from all 12 area festivals.

programs.name: 2027 IMEA Middle School/Junior High All-State Honor Choir
programs.description: IMEA's middle school/junior high honor choir, sponsored since 1990. Approximately 150 singers selected by the CSWS Committee from Circle the State with Song area festival participants. Separate audition tracks are provided for Soprano, Alto, Tenor, and Bass.

dates.title: 2027 Middle School All-State Honor Choir performance
dates.description: IMEA lists the 2027 performance dates as TBD; the performance location is the Fort Wayne Embassy Theatre, Fort Wayne, IN.

requirements.title: Must attend a Circle the State with Song Area Festival
requirements.description: Students attending Circle the State with Song Area Festivals are eligible to audition for the All-State Honor Choirs.

requirements.title: Recorded audition submitted online
requirements.description: Auditions are recorded along with the IMEA-provided audition tracks (separate tracks for Soprano, Alto, Tenor, Bass) and submitted online. Audition instructions must be followed exactly or the audition is disqualified.
